stationScope.evidence: EVR's official 2026 e-mobility page publishes own-network prices separately from roaming. The certified BNetzA EVSE-prefix audit identifies DE*EVR as 59/59 points owned by Energieversorgung Rudolstadt GmbH.

roamingDeferred.reason: EVR publishes separate roaming prices (0.59 EUR/kWh AC and 0.71 EUR/kWh DC). Those eMSP terms are deliberately excluded from physical-CPO pricing.

adHocDeferred.reason: EVR states that QR/PayPal payment is available at its stations, but the page does not explicitly state that the EVR-Ladekarte price applies to QR/PayPal sessions. No ad-hoc price is inferred.

note: Verified EVR-Ladekarte own-network tariff: 0.51 EUR/kWh AC and 0.61 EUR/kWh DC. Monthly fee 4.50 EUR; RFID acquisition 20 EUR once, waived for EVR electricity customers. DC blocking fee 0.10 EUR/min after 120 minutes, capped at 25 EUR per charging session.
